name: a human gets bored, has a go on the computer, and the screen says so

steps.note: the computer sits in cell (3, 3), the fridge in (9, 5) and the toilet in (9, 1)
paused, so the only ticks this world takes are the ones asked for below —
otherwise the frames between two steps would advance it by however many
this machine managed, and the moments photographed here are exact ones

steps.shot: an office, and a computer nobody is using

steps.note: hunger, thirst and a bladder switched off, so this is a test about being
bored rather than a race between four needs. Fun is left running: it is
the one that drains here, and its level was rolled at spawn like the rest
fun drains over ten world hours; this one was rolled part way down it and
crosses 60 boredom at about tick 5400, a step from the desk. Half an hour
of world at the computer is 960 ticks, so 5900 is the middle of the go

steps.shot: the screen is on while somebody is sitting at it

steps.note: ...and a thousand ticks later the go is over and the screen is dark again

steps.expect_log: had a go on the computer at 3, 3

steps.shot: the go is over, and what its mind is doing now
the debug menu: fun, and the processes still running
